summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held on April 15, 2026. The only item voted on was a change of the company's corporate name to AXIA Energia S.A. and a corresponding amendment to the Bylaws. The filing includes a detailed voting map showing shareholder votes but no transaction, merger, acquisition, or other special situation event. This is a routine corporate governance filing. The filing does not involve a tender, restructuring, or any event that would classify as a special situation under event-driven analysis.
